visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a long side braid, wearing a white crochet hat and an open-knit white top over a lace dress, stands in a courtyard paved with reddish-brown bricks. She looks at the camera and speaks with high facial animation and hand gestures, while a person in orange robes walks in the distant background near a white temple building under an overcast sky. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of a large, weathered bronze bell embossed with intricate patterns, hanging from a wooden frame. A person's hand with a ring strikes the rim of the bell from below, and the woman holds a smartphone showing a digital tuner app with a needle vibrating over a green 'B' symbol. (3) The woman reacts with a wide smile and covers her mouth with her hand in surprise and delight, standing beside a female friend wearing glasses and a red-and-white plaid shirt. The setting is filled with similar large bells and green potted plants, creating a cultural or religious atmosphere. (4) In a closer framing, the woman points at her phone screen which now displays a large 'A' as she listens intently to another strike on a smaller bell nearby. She maintains a high level of energy, her eyes wide as she confirms the pitch shown on the digital interface. (5) The woman celebrates by jumping slightly and raising her arm in a victory pose while laughing heartily. She walks across the brick plaza towards her friend, the camera following her movement, showing more of the temple-like background with white benches and trees.
